name: ChuShi Music API
author: ChuShi
description: Reads real playback truth (track, position, play state, full word-level lyrics) from NetEase Music and relays it to the ChuShi SMTC engine; executes control commands strictly once at the element level. Read-only by design: NetEase Music's own UI and progress bar are never modified. Works with NetEase Music's built-in SMTC switch turned OFF.
